resources.string: Read-only, no popups; the sheet lands in the decision center (also runs monthly)

Current: %1$s (tap to cycle Strict→Standard→Delegated; hard red lines refused at every tier, tier-passed actions still recorded). The Delegated tier never shows a card and never offers a lease: it does not ask — act first, audit later (the ledger keeps the record); leases only appear in Strict/Standard tiers — that is not a broken lease
